div.h1: PR #5 - HUD: follows the world scale, never knows Game
div.p: Hud draws a bar, score, lives and GAME OVER on top of the world. main.ts feeds it plain values after every game update, so Game holds no reference to Hud.

text.tspan: Text in PIXI is a bitmap rendered once;
and text.text is assigned only on change.
bar: full world width x barHeight
score: anchor (1, 0.5), gap/2 left of centre
lives: anchor (0, 0.5), gap/2 right of centre
GAME OVER: anchor (0.5), centre of the screen
